description: Code in C/C++ source files that is not compiler output we still have to match. Kinds: "asm" = written by hand in assembly in the original program; "inline-asm" = C function whose original source used an instruction C cannot express; "generated" = emitted by a build tool (dsprot stubs from the protection tool's encoding); "veneer" = linker-style literal-jump trampoline. Each reason names the instructions or origin. tools/progress/progress.py reports their linker-map bytes in their own categories; all but "inline-asm" (compiled C) are excluded from the compiled-code denominator. An entry applies only while its source still defines the function in that form; compiler output that is not yet matched does not belong here.
